note.zh: 基隆拿主要的免费移民安置机构，服务永久居民和难民（BC NSP 项目也服务工签持有人、国际学生和新入籍公民）；致电 250-763-8008 转 1。
note.en: Kelowna's main free settlement agency for permanent residents and refugees (BC NSP also serves work-permit holders, international students and new citizens); call 250-763-8008 ext. 1.

n: Kelowna Urgent and Primary Care Centre (UPCC)

note.zh: 无需预约的紧急门诊；没有家庭医生也可以就诊。
note.en: Walk-in urgent care with no appointment; can be used without a family doctor.

note.zh: 省政府服务窗口——办理 BC 服务卡/MSP 医保、收入援助等省政府业务；周一至周五 9:00–16:30。
note.en: Provincial services in person — BC Services Card/MSP, income assistance and other BC government help; open Mon–Fri 9:00–4:30.

n: Kelowna Service Canada Centre and Passport Services

note.zh: 联邦政府服务窗口——办理社会保险号（SIN）、护照、就业保险、CPP/OAS 养老金；请携带移民身份文件；周一至周五 8:30–16:00。
note.en: Federal services in person — Social Insurance Number (SIN), passports, EI, CPP/OAS; bring your immigration documents; open Mon–Fri 8:30–4:00.

note.zh: 换领外国驾照、参加笔试/路考、办理 BC 身份证；请在网上预约，并携带原驾照和移民身份文件。
note.en: Exchange your foreign driver's licence, take knowledge/road tests and get a BC ID; book an appointment online and bring your licence and immigration documents.

n: ICBC West Kelowna Driver Licensing (by appointment only)

note.zh: 位于西基隆拿市政厅二楼的驾照办理处——驾照更新、笔试及 4/5/7 级路考，仅限预约。
note.en: Driver licensing on the 2nd floor of West Kelowna City Hall — licence renewals, knowledge tests and Class 4/5/7 road tests, by appointment only.

note.zh: 免费求职帮助、就业辅导和培训资助；周一至周四 8:00–18:00，周五 9:00–16:00。
note.en: Free job-search help, employment counselling and training funding for job seekers; open Mon–Thu 8–6, Fri 9–4.

note.zh: 为西基隆拿居民提供免费求职和就业服务；周一至周四 8:00–18:00，周五 9:00–16:00。
note.en: Free job-search help and employment services for West Kelowna residents; open Mon–Thu 8–6, Fri 9–4.

n: Legal Aid BC – Kelowna (Kelowna Law Courts)

note.zh: 低收入人士可在此申请免费法律援助（家庭法、刑事及部分移民案件）；周一至周四 9:00–12:00、13:00–16:00，周五 9:00–12:00。
note.en: Apply for free legal aid (family, criminal, some immigration matters) if you have a low income; open Mon–Thu 9–12 & 1–4, Fri 9–12.

note.zh: 免费法律咨询和代理，涉及租房、收入/残疾援助、就业保险、劳动、家庭法等法律援助不覆盖的问题。
note.en: Free legal advice and representation on tenancy, income/disability assistance, EI, employment, family law and other issues that legal aid doesn't cover.

note.zh: 免费领取食物，需预约；请先在网上登记，并携带每位成人的带照片证件、每个孩子的身份证明以及基隆拿/西基隆拿的住址证明。
note.en: Free food by appointment; register online first and bring photo ID for each adult, ID for each child and proof of a Kelowna/West Kelowna address.

note.zh: 警察非紧急电话及前台（周一至周五 8:00–17:30），可报案、办理无犯罪记录证明和指纹；紧急情况请拨 911。
note.en: Police non-emergency line and front counter (Mon–Fri 8–5:30) for reports, criminal record checks and fingerprinting; call 911 for emergencies.

n: Kelowna RCMP – Rutland Community Police Office

note.zh: 位于拉特兰的社区警务站，可咨询、投诉和报案（周一至周五 9:00–16:30）；非紧急用途。
note.en: Neighbourhood police office in Rutland for general information, complaints and crime reports (Mon–Fri 9–4:30); not for emergencies.

note.zh: 西基隆拿警察非紧急电话及前台（周一至周五 8:00–16:30），可办理无犯罪记录证明；紧急情况请拨 911。
note.en: Police non-emergency line and front counter for West Kelowna (Mon–Fri 8–4:30), including criminal record checks; call 911 for emergencies.

note.zh: 24小时急诊科；危及生命的紧急情况请拨打 9-1-1。
note.en: 24-hour emergency department; call 9-1-1 for life-threatening emergencies.

n: Rutland Urgent and Primary Care Centre (UPCC)

note.zh: 位于 Rutland 的免预约紧急门诊，无需预约。
note.en: Walk-in urgent care in Rutland; no appointment needed.

n: West Kelowna Urgent and Primary Care Centre (UPCC)

note.zh: 西基隆拿的免预约紧急门诊；没有家庭医生也可以就诊。
note.en: Walk-in urgent care in West Kelowna; can be used without a family doctor.

note.zh: 免预约诊所；名额有限，建议早到排队。
note.en: Walk-in clinic, no appointment needed; arrive early because it fills up.

n: Evolve Allied Health - Kelowna Glenmore (Hillside) Walk-in Clinic

note.zh: 工作日免预约诊所；也可致电预约当天的电话问诊。
note.en: Weekday walk-in clinic; you can also call to book a same-day phone appointment.

note.zh: 西基隆拿的免预约诊所，无需预约。
note.en: Walk-in clinic in West Kelowna, no appointment needed.

note.zh: Interior Health 心理健康与成瘾服务中心；无需医生转介，可拨打 310-MHSU（6478）联系。
note.en: Interior Health mental health and substance use centre; no doctor referral needed - call 310-MHSU (6478) to connect.

n: Shoppers Drug Mart Orchard Park S.C.

note.zh: 药房每天营业至晚上10点。
note.en: Pharmacy open until 10 p.m. every day.

note.zh: Rutland 区药房，每天营业至晚上10点。
note.en: Pharmacy in Rutland open until 10 p.m. every day.

note.zh: 西基隆拿药房，每天营业至晚上10点。
note.en: Pharmacy in West Kelowna open until 10 p.m. every day.

note.zh: 为低收入或领取救济者提供的低价牙科服务；不做牙冠、牙桥或假牙。
note.en: Low-cost dental care for people on low income or income assistance; no crowns, bridges or dentures.

note.zh: 基洛纳最大的奥卡纳根区域图书馆分馆；居民可免费办理借书证，借阅图书、电子书并使用电脑和 Wi-Fi。
note.en: The largest ORL branch in Kelowna; a library card is free for residents and gives access to books, e-books, computers and Wi-Fi.

note.zh: 位于 Mission 区、紧邻 H2O 中心的图书馆分馆，停车免费。
note.en: Library branch in the Mission next to H2O; parking is free.

note.zh: Rutland 区的图书馆分馆，位于 33 号公路旁的商业广场内，靠近 Rutland 公交换乘站。
note.en: Rutland's library branch, in a shopping plaza on Highway 33 near the Rutland transit exchange.

note.zh: 西基洛纳图书馆分馆，可在市政厅停车场免费停车，周日闭馆。
note.en: West Kelowna's library branch; free parking in the City Hall lot. Closed Sundays.

n: Central Okanagan Public Schools (SD23) – School Board Office

note.zh: 基洛纳和西基洛纳公立学校的学区总部；入学登记和学区划分问题可从这里开始咨询。
note.en: School district head office for Kelowna and West Kelowna public schools; start here for registration and catchment questions.

note.zh: 公立高中，10–12 年级（校名中的 École 表示提供法语沉浸课程）。
note.en: Public secondary school for grades 10–12 (École = offers French Immersion).

note.zh: 服务 Rutland 区的公立高中（9–12 年级）。
note.en: Public secondary school (grades 9–12) serving Rutland.

note.zh: 服务 Mission 区的公立高中（9–12 年级）。
note.en: Public secondary school (grades 9–12) serving the Mission area.

note.zh: 位于西基洛纳的公立高中（9–12 年级），属于第 23 学区。
note.en: Public secondary school (grades 9–12) in West Kelowna, part of SD23.

n: UBC Okanagan (University of British Columbia, Okanagan campus)

note.zh: UBC 大学奥卡纳根校区，位于基洛纳北部、机场附近，市中心和 Rutland 有频繁公交直达。
note.en: UBC's Okanagan campus in north Kelowna near the airport, with frequent buses from downtown and Rutland.

note.zh: 奥卡纳根学院主校区，提供文凭、技工、大学转学分及英语语言课程。
note.en: Okanagan College's main campus, offering diplomas, trades, university transfer and English language programs.

note.zh: 基洛纳市中心的主要公交换乘站，包括 97 路快速公交在内的多条线路在此交汇。
note.en: Downtown Kelowna's main bus exchange, where many routes including RapidBus 97 meet.

a: Cooper Rd at Hwy 97 (Harvey Ave), by Orchard Park mall

note.zh: 位于 Orchard Park 购物中心旁的 Midtown 繁忙公交换乘站，可前往 UBCO、Rutland 和市中心。
note.en: Busy Midtown bus exchange at Orchard Park shopping centre, connecting to UBCO, Rutland and downtown.

a: Shepherd Rd between Asher Rd and Roxby Rd

note.zh: Rutland 区的公交换乘站，近期完成升级，可前往 UBCO、Orchard Park 和市中心。
note.en: Rutland's bus exchange, recently upgraded, with links to UBCO, Orchard Park and downtown.

a: Transit Way / Alumni Ave, UBC Okanagan campus

note.zh: 位于 UBC 奥卡纳根校区内的公交换乘站，有 97 路快速公交等线路。
note.en: Bus exchange on the UBC Okanagan campus, served by RapidBus 97 and other routes.

a: K.L.O. Rd (north side) at Okanagan College

note.zh: 位于奥卡纳根学院基洛纳校区的公交换乘站；2026 年扩建期间设有临时换乘点。
note.en: Bus exchange at Okanagan College's Kelowna campus; under expansion in 2026 with a temporary exchange during construction.

n: Towne Centre Card Shop (Canada Post outlet)

note.zh: 位于市中心 Bernard 大道一家贺卡店内的邮局柜台，周一至周六营业。
note.en: Downtown post office counter inside a card shop on Bernard Avenue; open Mon–Sat.

note.zh: 市政府主要的康乐中心，设有泳池、体育馆和健身课程，可单次入场或办会员。
note.en: The City's main recreation centre with a pool, gym and fitness programs; drop-in and memberships available.

note.zh: 位于 Mission 区的市属水上及健身中心，由 YMCA 运营，设有适合各年龄段的滑道和泳池。
note.en: City-owned aquatic and fitness centre in the Mission, operated by the YMCA, with waterslides and pools for all ages.

note.zh: 市中心大型湖滨公园，有沙滩、夏季儿童水上乐园、游乐场、球场和无绳遛狗区。
note.en: Large downtown lakefront park with a sandy beach, summer waterpark, playground, sports courts and an off-leash dog run.

note.zh: 沿溪而建的大型公园，有步道；狗必须拴绳。
note.en: Large creekside park with walking trails; dogs must be on leash.

note.zh: 位于下 Mission 区的杂货店，自称拥有基洛纳最齐全的印度食品。
note.en: Grocery store in the Lower Mission that says it has the largest selection of Indian groceries in Kelowna.

note.zh: SD23 学区的欢迎中心：刚到加拿大的家庭在这里给孩子办入学登记；这里也有校园安置服务（SWIS），帮助刚来的家庭适应学校。
note.en: SD23’s Welcome Centre: families new to Canada register their children for school here. Also home to Settlement Workers in Schools (SWIS), who help families settle into school life.

note.zh: SD23 学区公立小学。孩子上哪所学校由家庭住址决定，先在学区网站查学区划分（catchment）。
note.en: SD23 public elementary school. Which school your child attends depends on your home address — check the district’s catchment map first.
note.fr: École primaire publique du SD23. L’école de votre enfant dépend de votre adresse — consultez d’abord la carte des secteurs du district.
note.es: Escuela primaria pública del SD23. La escuela de su hijo depende de su dirección: consulte primero el mapa de zonas del distrito.

note.ja: SD23 の公立小学校。通う学校は住所で決まるので、まず学区の通学区域（catchment）を確認してください。

note.zh: SD23 学区公立初中（middle school）。入学按家庭住址划分，先查学区划分。
note.en: SD23 public middle school. Attendance is by home address — check the catchment map first.

note.zh: 持牌托儿机构（BC 省政府开放数据）。托儿位普遍紧张，去之前先打电话问有没有空位、收什么年龄段。年龄：3 岁以下、2 岁半到 5 岁、课后托管（1 年级到 12 岁）。参加省政府的托儿费减免计划（CCFRI）。
note.en: Licensed child care (BC government open data). Spaces are scarce — call first to ask about openings and the ages they take. Ages: under 3, 2½ to 5, before/after school (grade 1 to age 12). In the provincial fee-reduction programme (CCFRI).
note.fr: Garderie autorisée (données ouvertes du gouvernement de la C.-B.). Les places sont rares — téléphonez d’abord pour demander s’il y a de la place et quels âges sont acceptés. Âges : moins de 3 ans, 2 ans et demi à 5 ans, avant et après l’école (1re année à 12 ans). Participe au programme provincial de réduction des frais (CCFRI).
note.es: Guardería con licencia (datos abiertos del gobierno de BC). Hay pocas plazas: llame antes para preguntar por vacantes y las edades que aceptan. Edades: menores de 3 años, de 2 años y medio a 5, antes y después de la escuela (de 1.º grado a 12 años). Participa en el programa provincial de reducción de cuotas (CCFRI).
note.ko: 허가받은 보육시설(BC주 정부 공개 데이터). 자리가 부족하니 먼저 전화해 빈자리와 받는 연령을 물어보세요. 연령: 3세 미만, 2세 반~5세, 방과 전후 돌봄(1학년~12세). 주 정부 보육료 감면 프로그램(CCFRI) 참여.
note.ja: 認可保育施設（BC州政府のオープンデータ）。空きが少ないので、まず電話で空き状況と受け入れ年齢を確認してください。年齢：3歳未満、2歳半〜5歳、学童保育（1年生〜12歳）。州の保育料軽減プログラム（CCFRI）に参加。
